Details.ProductTitle: Bartholomew (btp-guard) — Sub-50µs AI Agent Safety & Invariant Gate
Details.ShortDescription: The fastest AI agent safety layer on Earth. 30,000x faster than AWS Bedrock Guardrails. Zero network overhead. Cryptographically signed execution receipts.
Details.LongDescription:
Bartholomew (btp-guard) is a deterministic in-memory invariant gate and cryptographic attestation protocol for autonomous AI agent fleets.

When AI agents (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Bedrock Agents) execute tool calls—bash commands, SQL mutations, file writes, API requests—Bartholomew intercepts every action before OS execution in under 50 microseconds, directly in caller memory.

Key Results (Live-Verified on AWS Bedrock, Claude Sonnet 4.6):
• 47.8 µs decision latency vs 1,450 ms Bedrock Guardrail API round-trip (30,338x faster)
• 80% reduction in cloud guardrail token billing ($0.00 per local check)
• 100% deterministic AST-level invariant enforcement (no probabilistic LLM safety layers)
• FIPS 186-5 Ed25519 cryptographic non-repudiation receipts for every approved agent action
• SOC 2-ready audit trail with RFC 8785 canonical JSON attestation

Supported Frameworks:
• Amazon Bedrock Agents & Converse API
• LangGraph & LangChain (CallbackHandler)
• Microsoft AutoGen & Semantic Kernel
• CrewAI tool guards
• MCP stdio proxy (Claude Desktop, Cursor)

Installation:
• Python: pip install btp-guard
• Node.js: npm install btp-guard
• AWS CDK: npm install aws-cdk-bartholomew-guard

License: Source-available. Free tier for individuals and startups under $1M ARR. Enterprise license from $499/month.
Highlights: 30,338x faster than AWS Bedrock Guardrails — live-benchmarked against Claude Sonnet 4.6
